e6: Not run here: it needs a second source of jump readings on past events. No analogs are picked for resolved markets, and Hyperliquid's weekend windows reach back only about 200 days. The AI prior knows how most of them ended; `redkeep baseline` (E9) scores it beside the market's reading on those that resolved after its training data.
